CFML Language Reference: Functions

URLDecode

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Converts a URL-encoded string back to plain text: each %XX escape becomes the character with that hexadecimal code, and each plus sign becomes a space.

Category

String functions

Syntax

URLDecode(urlEncodedString)

Parameters

urlEncodedString
A string encoded with URLEncodedFormat or by a browser.

Returns

The decoded string.

Usage

KoldFusion already decodes URL and FORM variables for you, so you only need this function for strings you assemble yourself, such as a query string read from a log file or a CFHTTP result.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Encoded = "name=Tom%20%26%20Jerry&city=New+York&note=100%25+sure">
<UL>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Encoded#" DELIMITERS="&" INDEX="pair">
<CFOUTPUT><LI>#ListFirst(pair, "=")# = #URLDecode(ListLast(pair, "="))#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</UL>

See also

URLEncodedFormat, CFLOCATION, CFHTTP
